title: Miso Glazed Salmon
description: Salmon fillets marinated in a sweet-salty miso glaze, then broiled until caramelised. A weeknight staple that feels special.

ingredients.text: Spring onions and sesame seeds, to serve

steps: Mix miso, mirin, sake, soy sauce, sesame oil, and sugar into a smooth paste.
Coat salmon fillets generously with the marinade. Leave for at least 30 minutes, or up to 24 hours in the fridge.
Preheat grill/broiler to high. Line a tray with foil.
Wipe excess marinade from salmon (it burns easily) and place skin-side down on the tray.
Grill for 10–12 minutes until glaze is deeply caramelised and fish flakes easily. No need to flip.
Scatter with sliced spring onions and sesame seeds. Serve with steamed rice.
notes: White miso is milder and sweeter than red; either works but reduce sugar slightly with red miso. The longer the marinade, the deeper the flavour.
